subject: Ambassador partnership: SCCs/TIA gateway playbook and subprocessor alignment
body:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@ambassador.cloud>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>, security@ambassador.cloud
Date: Mon, 09 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ambassador partnership: quick sync on SCCs/TIA gateway

Hi Olga / Kimberly —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As we discussed with Product, Ambassador is excited to get a lightweight gateway pattern integrated so our EU customers can keep traffic within their preferred routing while still using the Redwood-hosted models for burst inference. Attached is the high-level network diagram and an initial mapping of the SCCs fields we think will be relevant.

Open questions we flagged:
- Do you consider the gateway an Ambassador subprocessor for the purposes of SCCs/UK Addendum?
- If yes, would we need a delegation flow for logging (our edge collects minimal telemetry)?
- Do you have a recommended TIA scoping for edge caching that still preserves your residency commitments?

I attached a short delta matrix (ambassador-sccs-delta-matrix.xlsx) and a draft playbook. Could your team review and call out must-haves? We have a partner enablement deadline of 2028-07-22.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Torres
Partnerships Lead | Ambassador Cloud
elena.torres@ambassador.cloud

-----Original Message-----
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@ambassador.cloud>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 09 Jul 2028 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Ambassador partnership: quick sync on SCCs/TIA gateway

Elena —

Great to meet earlier. Quick notes from our side to get alignment before we hand off to legal/security:

1) Subprocessor classification: if Ambassador's gateway decrypts or persists any request payload beyond ephemeral routing (even transient cache), it will be considered a subprocessor under our DPA and covered by SCCs/UK IDTA considerations.
2) Logging & telemetry: Redwood can accept redacted logs over a secure channel (TLS 1.3) with retention options limited by region; if Ambassador wants logs forwarded to your ops, we need a signed subprocessor addendum.
3) TIA scoping: For TIAs/DTIAs we propose a scoped control set that treats the gateway as a processor edge with strictly enforced "no-persist" defaults; exceptions require documented business justification and a TIA exception ticket.

Action items for Ambassador: review the attached delta matrix, confirm whether your gateway will store short-lived KV caches, and share the edge architecture diagram.

Attachments: ambassador-sccs-delta-matrix.xlsx, playbook-draft-v1.md

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Privacy Program Manager | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.inference

---
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>, Elena Torres <elena.torres@ambassador.cloud>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Ambassador partnership: quick sync on SCCs/TIA gateway

Thanks both — quick clarifications from legal/ops:

- Classification: If the gateway performs any content-based enrichment (e.g., rate-limiting decisions based on payload attributes) it is a subprocessor. Simple L4/L7 routing that keeps request bodies opaque to the gateway tends to avoid subprocessor status — but we need concrete diagrams.
- Delegated controls: Where Ambassador can commit to not storing request bodies and to rotate any ephemeral keys monthly, we can accept a minimal subprocessor addendum rather than a full exhibit.
- UK Addendum: Given Ambassador has EU and UK customers, we will need a mapping that shows which physical nodes serve UK-originated requests so we can maintain UK IDTA attestations.

Please add Marta from Partner Ops to the loop for implementation cadence.

KK
Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.inference

---
From: Marta Ruiz <marta@partner-ops.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@ambassador.cloud>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 14:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ambassador partnership: quick sync on SCCs/TIA gateway

Hi team — looping in our deployment PM. Quick note: Ambassador can present a per-region node inventory by 2028-07-15 and has agreed to provide a signed statement on log handling. Attaching the initial TIA-gaplog (TIA-gaplog.pdf).

We will also propose a short test window (7 days) where Ambassador routes EU traffic via the prototype gateway to validate routing headers and residency tags.

Cheers,
Marta Ruiz
Partner Ops | Partner Solutions Inc.

---
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>, Elena Torres <elena.torres@ambassador.cloud>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 12 Jul 2028 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Ambassador partnership: SCCs/TIA gateway playbook (next steps)

Thanks — quick operational decision from infra:

- We can support an edge gateway pattern provided Ambassador agrees to the following: no persistent request payloads on their nodes; ephemeral KV caches only (TTL <= 60 seconds); and signed attestation of node locations.
- Redwood will prepare a trimmed subprocessor addendum and a short TIA exhibit (controls mapped) for the pilot. I will circulate a draft by Monday 2028-07-15.

Next steps:
1) Ambassador: share node inventory and confirm caching TTL by 2028-07-15.
2) Redwood: draft subprocessor addendum + TIA exhibit for pilot (target 2028-07-18).
3) Both: schedule 7-day routing validation window (proposed 2028-07-20 — 2028-07-26).

If Ambassador can confirm the TTL and provide the attestation link, Kimberly and I will push the legal materials over the same day.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Infrastructure | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference

Attachments referenced: ambassador-sccs-delta-matrix.xlsx; TIA-gaplog.pdf; playbook-draft-v1.md
